paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between "Answer Popularity" and three variables: "Accuracy," "Confidence," and "Alignment," for Qwen2-7B on Movies. The X-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity," has a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 100, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 20. The Y-axis, labeled "Values," is also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 with labels at intervals of 0.2.

There are three distinct lines on the graph, each representing one of the variables. The "Accuracy" line is blue, marked with circles, and solid; it starts at approximately 0.15 when "Answer Popularity" is near 0, and increases steadily to around 0.68 as "Answer Popularity" approaches 100, with a notable steeper rise between 20 and 60 on the X-axis. The "Confidence" line is green, marked with triangles, and solid; it begins at about 0.7 when "Answer Popularity" is near 0 and rises to around 0.88 by the time "Answer Popularity" reaches 40, after which it plateaus. The "Alignment" line is red, marked with squares, and solid; it starts at roughly 0.45 when "Answer Popularity" is near 0 and generally increases to approximately 0.8 as "Answer Popularity" nears 100, with some minor fluctuations along the way.
